implementerProof.how: Re-ran the implementer's database-backed launcher proofs (TestAnAgentKeepsWritingPastItsCredentialsExpiry, TestAResumeUnderASessionDatabaseIsServedThroughTheProxy, TestStartUnderSQLStorageResumesOnlyASessionTheTableHolds and the five socket/refusal cases) against a PostgreSQL 16.2 started in this pod: all PASS at 5c6e2b34. Then drove the same surface further than its harness did: the real Oh My Pi v18.8.9 started by the real launcher (Run, not sessionproxy.Start alone) as a generation's child, writing and then resuming its conversation through the generation's socket — see proof[0].

failures.criterion: The listener holds its credential for the generation and nothing between generations (spec acceptance 3); PR body: 'the proxy stops with the child, before the generation's directory goes'.
failures.evidence: On the container's own SIGTERM (the launcher's context ending: pod deletion, eviction, node drain) the proxy stops BEFORE the child. sessionproxy.Start (internal/sessionproxy/sessionproxy.go, the goroutine `case <-ctx.Done(): _ = p.Close()`) is handed the launcher's Run context by startSession (internal/launcher/launcher.go:484), so the listener closes and the socket file is unlinked the moment the context ends, while Run's stopActive is still giving the child its StopGrace. Any connection the agent opens in that grace — its last session writes once Bun's pool has idled out after 5 s — is refused; the postgres store, which dials the database directly, has no such gap. Under the daemon's LauncherStop the same work is served. Observed live: a child that on SIGTERM runs psql through its generation's socket against a real PostgreSQL got `42` under the daemon's stop and `connection to server on socket ".../g1/.s.PGSQL.5432" failed: No such file or directory` under the container's SIGTERM. Red test, its own commit af071bc5: packages/daemon/internal/launcher/session_shutdown_test.go, TestASessionDatabaseServesItsChildThroughTheChildsShutdownGrace — `cd packages/daemon && go test -count=1 -run TestASessionDatabaseServesItsChildThroughTheChildsShutdownGrace ./internal/launcher/` fails on container_shutdown (`refused: dial unix …/g1/.s.PGSQL.5432: connect: no such file or directory`) and passes on daemon_stop, deterministically (-count=3). It goes green with startSession handing Start context.WithoutCancel(ctx), so wait() alone closes the proxy after the child exits (checked locally, then reverted); the fix is the implementer's.
